summary: Provider-neutral speech contracts (runs/events/capability) in @kms/domain and the speech-runs persistence schema + additive 0007 migration in @kms/database. No provider SDK types in domain/database.

databaseTests.integrationSkipped: Docker/integration tests are OUT OF SCOPE for T01 (unit tests only); pre-existing integration failures in test/t07 and test/t08 are unrelated to T01 and outside its file ownership.

persistence.migration: packages/database/drizzle/0007_speech_runs.sql (additive; statement-breakpoint style; no DROP/ALTER on existing tables)
persistence.idempotencyUniqueIndex: transcript_raw_events_idempotency_unique ON (run_id, part_id, provider, provider_event_id, event_type, sequence_in_part) WHERE part_id/provider_event_id/sequence_in_part IS NOT NULL

invariantsVerified: policy version locked (TranscriptionPolicyV1Schema version: z.literal(1); run.policySnapshot rejects version != 1)
owner-scoped (ownerId required min 1 on run/part/segment/event envelope; owner+meeting indexes)
immutability triggers (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE on transcript_runs and transcript_run_parts; BEFORE UPDATE + BEFORE DELETE on transcript_raw_events; SQLSTATE P0311)
raw SDK leakage absent (grep: only zod + internal imports; deepgram/local-whisper appear solely as enum string literals)
duplicates/out-of-order handled (partial unique idempotency index on dedupe key; sequenceInPart enables read-time ordering; conflict-on-content-hash is T05)
content-free safe errors (SpeechSafeErrorSchema .strict() with only code/message/category/retryable; rejects content/key/path fields)

dependencyNote.acyclicModuleGraph: capability.ts (leaf, defines SpeechProviderNameSchema) <- events.ts (imports SpeechProviderNameSchema; defines SpeechSafeErrorSchema) <- runs.ts (imports both; RunProviderSchema aliases SpeechProviderNameSchema). This breaks the otherwise-cyclic runs<->events reference that the spec's literal 'import from each other' would create (ESM live-binding TDZ). Intent preserved: single source of truth for the provider allowlist.
dependencyNote.migrationJournal: meta/_journal.json was intentionally NOT modified (outside T01 file ownership). The 0007 SQL is a self-contained, additive artifact; a subsequent drizzle-kit generate/journal update is the responsibility of the integration step (T05). Pre-existing t07 journal-count assertion (expects 6, journal already has 7 from 0000-0006) is unrelated to T01.

concerns: Pre-existing integration test failures (packages/database/test/t07-migration-restore.test.ts: 3 failures; test/t08-outbox-repo.test.ts: describe-level with 2 skipped) exist on the baseline BEFORE any T01 change and are outside T01's file ownership. T01 does not modify the drizzle migration journal or any file under test/.

drizzle migration journal (meta/_journal.json) and a 0007 snapshot were not authored (not in T01 ownership); the migrator will not apply 0007 until the journal is updated by a later step. The migration SQL itself is complete and unit-inspected.

fixesApplied.change: Column changed from text('event_type').notNull() to speechEventKindEnum('event_type').notNull(); migration emits "event_type" "speech_event_kind" NOT NULL (CREATE TYPE for speech_event_kind was already present and unchanged). Defense-in-depth: a raw row with event_type='bogus' is now rejected at the DB layer. Additive only — no DROP/ALTER introduced.
fixesApplied.regressionTest: src/schema/speech-runs.test.ts > '0007_speech_runs.sql migration' > 'I-1 regression: transcript_raw_events.event_type uses speech_event_kind enum (not text)' (string-inspection over the migration SQL).

fixesApplied.change: provider field switched from z.string().min(1) to SpeechProviderNameSchema (already imported at events.ts:3). Aligns with the SpeechEventSchema envelope and UsageReportSchema.provider. Eliminates the ambiguous-audit-trail case where payload.provider could disagree with the envelope provider.
regressionTests: src/transcript/events.test.ts > UsageEvent > 'I-2 regression: accepts payload.provider from SpeechProviderNameSchema (deepgram)'
src/transcript/events.test.ts > UsageEvent > 'I-2 regression: rejects payload.provider outside SpeechProviderNameSchema (azure)'
